guarantees.claim: sel_chk is continuously assigned the value of sel_o cast to type mux4_sel_e when the parameter Num equals 4.

assumptions.claim: sel_o must hold a value that can be cast to mux4_sel_e without producing an out-of-range enum literal.
assumptions.risk: If sel_o exceeds the legal mux4_sel_e range, sel_chk may become an invalid enum value that downstream logic may not handle, potentially bypassing mux select checks or causing simulation mismatches.

uncertain_points.claim: Downstream logic using sel_chk may not be robust against an invalid enum value if sel_o exceeds the defined mux4_sel_e values.
uncertain_points.cond: Num == 4 and sel_o takes an out-of-range value
uncertain_points.risk: Missing case coverage could let an illegal select pass through, leading to unintended mux behavior or hardware‑mismatch simulation.
